decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood line far from the firm's chemical-process core and only lightly signaled on the website, it is likely to fall below aspiration levels quickly and be cut so resources can be redeployed.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the firm's industrial capabilities and adjacent market logic, so boundedly rational management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep developing them.
A dedicated webpage suggests stronger commitment and perceived promise, and the product is close to the firm's process-technology base, making retention likely unless results clearly disappoint.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is strategically related but technologically and commercially more uncertain, so management would probably keep it for now while monitoring whether performance reaches aspiration levels.
